use np.asarray to avoid redundant copies from CoreML predictions
pre-allocate rgb_buf and use in-place post-processing ops (slower: 3 passes over array)
eliminate latent arithmetic allocations using out= buffers and pre-computed constants
float16 post-processing with pre-allocated buffers (float16 clip/copy much slower on aarch64)
use INTER_NEAREST for resize (faster for diffusion model input)
cv2.dnn.blobFromImage preprocessing (INTER_LINEAR + float32->float16 copy overhead)
in-place feedback blend into _lat_buf (5 numpy calls outweigh 3 alloc savings)
pre-build CoreML input dicts in init (avoid per-frame dict alloc + coremltools overhead)
CHW post-processing with pre-alloc buffer, return BGR view (skip cvtColor, avoid 3 float32 allocs)
float16 view for VAE decode + mixed np.add (float16+float32->float32 slow)
pre-alloc uint8 + np.copyto(unsafe) slower than astype for float32->uint8
np.take per channel into CHW (3 calls overhead outweighs 1 fancy-index + copyto)
np.copyto float16->float32 widening (asarray dtype=float32 is faster)
LATENT_FEEDBACK=0, remove all feedback code (simpler pipeline, 11 fewer lines)
ComputeUnit.ALL for VAE enc/dec (ANE overhead makes small models slower)
pre-alloc resize buffer, cv2.resize dst= (avoid 786KB uint8 alloc per frame)
skip np.clip in post-processing (0.6ms saved, one full 3MB pass eliminated)
copyto directly into pre-alloc buffers (skip np.asarray intermediates for enc/unet outputs)

float16 LUT for VAE decode (fancy-index overhead + dtype cast outweigh 3MB alloc savings)
gc.collect()+gc.disable() before benchmark (GC pauses negligible at <0.02ms savings)

cv2.LUT for uint8->float16 normalization (6x faster than numpy fancy-index gather)
per-channel cv2.LUT+dst= (3 Python calls overhead negate transposed-copyto savings)
pre-alloc cv2.LUT dst= (malloc reuse in loop, <0.01ms savings)
float32 img_buf+LUT (isolated enc 0.9ms faster but 0.017ms in full pipeline — noise)
float32 latent arithmetic (skip f32->f16 conversions, UNet faster with f32 input)
float32 img_buf+LUT combined with float32 latent (encoder slower with f32 input here)

float32 img_buf+LUT retry (2 runs avg 35.073ms, consistently slower by 0.049ms)
float32 prompt embeddings (f16 cast removal — f32 emb slower by 0.058ms in full pipeline)

skip 3MB np.copyto: dict update + per-frame alloc GC overhead outweighs copy savings
reformulate denoise as clean+k*(noise-npred): _lat_buf read not a bottleneck
INTER_NEAREST resize + blobFromImage no-resize: 0.006ms noise, adds complexity
warmup with real benchmark frames (worse: benchmark warmup sufficient, abstract warmup better for CoreML JIT)
simplify: remove self._fixed_noise member and np.asarray() no-ops (avg 2 runs, 0.096ms worse — within noise but technically higher)
256-res VAE enc/dec: latent upsample 32→64 for UNet, downsample 64→32 for decoder, resize output 256→512 (avg 2 runs, 6.7ms savings)
INTER_NEAREST for 256→512 output resize (avg 2 runs, 0.035ms within noise)
np.repeat upsample 32→64 (2 C calls vs 4 strided assigns, 0.076ms faster + simpler)
skip bgr_small copyto (cv2 copies internally, 0.064ms worse)
